note_ko: 장소 디테일 기준(docs/장소팩_작성기준.md)에 따라 작성(2026-10-25 추가). {s}/{S}=she/She, {p}/{P}=her/Her, {o}=her, {lit}=빛이 닿는 의상 부분.
setting_en: an underground subway platform with a tiled wall and a train waiting at the edge
feature_en: a wall of white square tiles with a green line along the middle
a yellow safety line painted along the platform edge
ground_en: a smooth gray stone platform floor
yellow tactile tiles along the edge

a few round station signs hanging far down the platform

낮 운행.sky_en: even white light from the ceiling panels
